newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, swaps stable and ecu/drachma firms.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, swaps stable and ecu/drachma firms.

text.p: Greek interbank deposits and forex forwards were stable late Friday, and the ecu firmed versus the drachma on the crisis in neighbouring Albania, dealers said.
"Depos and swaps had another quiet day," a state bank dealer said.
The central bank kept its intervention rate in overnight money unchanged at 11.90 percent.

"Bonds are quiet except for the last fixed coupon bond for which there is some buying interest. The bond has regained some 20 basis points in terms of price lost on Thursday," said a foreign bank bond dealer said.
"No price changes were noted on Friday and volume was very thin," a state bank dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 157.25/35 from Friday's 157.440 fix, the dollar at 268.23/33 drachmas from 268.390 and the Ecu at 305.40/50 from 305.530 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is trading at 305.50-55. There was domestic buying interest of ecus for drachmas that drove their exchange rate up to 305.70 around fixing time," a foreign forex bank dealer said.
The dealer said the buying was linked to uncertainty caused by the crisis in neighbouring Albania.
Greek Deputy Foreign Minister Yannos Kranidiotis will attend a meeting aimed at ending violence in Albania aboard an Italian warship off the Balkan country's Adriatic coast.

Another European mediator, the former Austrian chancellor Franz Vranitzky, has also planned to meet Albanian government ministers on Friday aboard the ship as part of an international effort to halt more than a month of political violence.
Greece is concerned with the crisis just across its northern border.

"The ecu is benefitting from the Albanian crisis whereas the drachma is clearly harmed. However, if any step is taken towards the direction of resolving the Albanian crisis, the drachma will start rising again," the dealer said.
The National Bank of Greece, the domestic money market's biggest player, quoted the following late rates:
** Overnight at 11.40-11.90
** One week at 11.40-11.90
** Two weeks at 11.40-11.90
** Three weeks at 11.40-11.90
** One month at 11.35-11.85
** Two months at 11.30-11.80
** Three months at 11.25-11.75
** Six months at 11.05-11.55
** Nine months at 10.90-11.40
** Twelve months at 10.75-11.25
--Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-41
